name: Sonya
source:
A genius magician brought up by the Elinun magician's guild, Sonya is dispatched to the Lunoush archipelago with orders to secure the rings. She encounters Damon's pirate gang and easily hijacks and seizes command of his ship, casting a spell on Damon transforming him into a pink organism to serve as her guide and to prevent him from escaping (she also likes his cute appearance).

Although she generally speaks with a monotone, offence is taken when she is treated like a child because of her build and appearance. She also has a sharp tongue and is indifferent to the fate of her defeated foes.
